notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
- Fix minor bug where demolish icons may linger during multi-build
- Back-end update to prepare for upcoming visual mod

notes.title: Update August 29, 2022
notes.content:
- UI improvement: keep bottom menu visible when showing main windows to let player click other menu buttons without closing window first
- Controls update: Allow road build by holding [Shift] and clicking to create straight paths without dragging
- Controls update: Add hotkey [Shift] to toggle multi-build

notes.title: Update August 25, 2022 #2
notes.content:
- Fix bug where using multi-build when Build Confirmation disabled in settings causes unexpected behaviour
- Fix bug in multi-build where some spots are shown incorrectly as invalid
- UI: Increase size of Multi button

notes.title: Pocket City - Official Release and First Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42764296/756e1f3bd94837300c9d4188fae7e6bbc2403b79.png

Pocket City is now available on the Steam store! An initial update has been added with minor bug fixes and a new feature to expand the bottom menu to show build options. To activate the expanded menu, click on the arrow button beside the menu. Enjoy!

- Bobby
